items.title: Alibaba's open-weight Qwen-Image-2.1 claims to beat closed models in image generation with just 7 billion parameters
items.summary: Alibaba's Qwen team has released Qwen-Image-2.1, an open-weight model that generates and edits images on powerful consumer GPUs, with support for transparency and up to ten reference images at once. Its research license bars commercial use, which requires a separate Qwen license. The article Alibaba's open-weight Qwen-Image-2.1 claims to beat closed models in image generation with just 7 billion parameters appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Tencent's Gander aims to keep talking while it works in the background
items.summary: Tencent's Gander processes speech, images, and text while handling tasks in the background. A "cerebellum" keeps the conversation going, while a swappable "brain" searches files, writes code, or tackles other complex work. Users can interrupt or change the task mid-conversation. In benchmarks, Gander interrupted users in just 8 percent of cases, less often than its rivals, but trailed on task accuracy. The article Tencent's Gander aims to keep talking while it works in the background appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 騰訊的 Gander 可以處理語音、影像和文字，同時在背景執行任務。「小腦」維持對話持續進行，而可替換的「大腦」則負責搜尋檔案、撰寫程式碼或處理其他複雜的工作。使用者可以在對話進行到一半時打斷或變更任務。在基準測試中，Gander 打斷使用者的比例僅佔 8%，比競爭對手更少，但在任務準確度上則落後。《The Decoder》網站首先刊登了題為 騰訊的 Gander 旨在於背景工作時持續保持對話 騰訊的 的文章。

items.title: Runway wants to turn AI video generation into a live stream you control in real time
items.summary: Runway wants to stream AI video as users prompt it, rather than make them wait for finished clips. The approach builds on GWM-1, its world model that generates video frame by frame. Beyond creative tools, Runway sees uses in robotics and autonomous driving. The article Runway wants to turn AI video generation into a live stream you control in real time appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Runway 希望能在使用者輸入提示時就以串流方式播放 AI 影片，而不是讓他們等待完成的短片。這項方法奠基於其世界模型 GWM-1 上，該模型能逐幀生成影片。除了創意工具之外，Runway 也看到了它在機器人與自動駕駛領域的應用。這篇題為 Runway wants to turn AI video generation into a live stream you control in real time 的文章最先出現在 The Decoder。

items.title: Daily AI usage in the U.S. has more than doubled in just six months
items.summary: Surveys by Epoch AI and Ipsos suggest AI is becoming part of everyday life for more Americans. The share of US adults using AI almost daily more than doubled between March and August 2026, rising from 8 percent to 19 percent. Meanwhile, the share using it just once a week fell from 17 percent to 10 percent. The article Daily AI usage in the U.S. has more than doubled in just six months appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Epoch AI 與 Ipsos 的調查顯示，人工智慧正逐漸成為更多美國人日常生活的一部分。在 2026 年 3 月至 8 月期間，幾乎每天都在使用的美國成年人比例成長了一倍以上，從 8% 上升至 19%。同時，僅每週使用一次的比例則從 17% 下降至 10%。文章〈Daily AI usage in the U.S. has more than doubled in just six months〉最初發布於 The Decoder。

items.title: Simulated students that make realistic mistakes help AI tutors learn faster
items.summary: Microsoft and the University of Illinois built StudentSim to replicate individual students from limited data and give AI tutors fast, low-cost feedback. In tests covering 60 students across chess, English, and math, it outperformed GPT-5.4. A chess tutor trained with StudentSim also earned the highest expert ratings among three versions tested. The article Simulated students that make realistic mistakes help AI tutors learn faster appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 微軟 與伊利諾大學合作建立了 StudentSim，透過有限的資料來模擬個別學生，為 AI 家教提供快速、低成本的回饋。在涵蓋棋藝、英文和數學等 60 名學生的測試中，它的表現優於 GPT-5.4。由 StudentSim 訓練出來的棋藝家教也在受測的三個版本中獲得最高的專家評分。文章〈Simulated students that make realistic mistakes help AI tutors learn faster〉最初發布於 The Decoder。

items.title: Following OpenAI, Anthropic is also reportedly postponing its IPO
items.summary: Anthropic is reportedly delaying its IPO from October to November 2026 to present strong Q3 results. Investors expect a roughly $2 trillion valuation, but rising infrastructure costs, including $1.25 billion a month for its SpaceX deal alone, and unresolved security risks complicate the listing. The article Following OpenAI, Anthropic is also reportedly postponing its IPO appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 據傳 Anthropic 正在將其首次公開募股（IPO）從 2026 年 10 月延後至 11 月，以便呈現強勁的第三季業績。投資人預期估值約為 2 兆美元，但不斷上升的基礎設施成本（僅與 SpaceX 合作案每月就高達 12.5 億美元）以及未解決的安全風險使上市變得複雜。這篇報導「繼 OpenAI 之後，據傳 Anthropic 也將延後首次公開募股（IPO）」首先發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: 通義千問開源 Qwen-Image-2.1:7B 參數實現文生圖與圖像編輯一體化
items.summary: 9月21日，通義千問團隊開源新一代圖像模型Qwen-Image-2.1。該模型以僅7B參數的輕量視覺生成模塊，統一文生圖、透明圖像生成與多種圖像編輯能力，實現生成效果、推理效率與使用成本的新平衡。其視覺生成採用32層Single-Stream DiT結構，藉助混合粒度注意力與KV Cache複用機制，優化多圖輸入場景下的效率與表現。

items.title: Humans, not rogue AI, are still the biggest cybersecurity risk to energy systems
items.summary: Before recent high-profile hacks raised the specter of AI possibly "killing all humans," our energy systems were already disturbingly vulnerable to cyberattack - and the risk is growing. "We were always prey. We were just kind of surviving at the appetite of our predators," Joshua Corman, executive in residence for public safety and resilience at […]

items.title: llm-keys-ui 0.1
items.summary: Release: llm-keys-ui 0.1 This plugin solves a very specific problem. I've started using Codex Remote to run coding agents on various machines while controlling them from my phone. Sometimes I use those machines to hack on LLM projects, and occasionally that means I need to configure an API key. I don't like pasting API keys into agent sessions, so I wanted a way to get those keys onto a machine without pasting them into the ChatGPT app directly. With this plugin, I can tell Codex to run: uvx --with llm-keys-ui llm keys-ui --all Then have it tell me the URL - including local network or Tailscale device IPs - for an interface to save additional API keys. Then later it can use a command like llm keys get anthropic as part of a shell command when it needs to use a key. Tags: llm , coding-agents , codex
items.summary_zh: 釋出：llm-keys-ui 0.1 這個外掛程式解決了一個非常特定的問題。我開始使用 Codex Remote 在各種機器上執行編碼代理程式，同時透過手機來控制它們。有時候我會使用那些機器來開發 LLM 專案，這偶爾意味著我需要設定 API 金鑰。我不喜歡將 API 金鑰貼到代理程式的工作階段中，所以我希望有一種方法可以將這些金鑰放到機器上，而不需要直接將它們貼到 ChatGPT 應用程式中。有了這個外掛程式，我可以告訴 Codex 執行：uvx --with llm-keys-ui llm keys-ui --all 然後讓它告訴我介面的網址（包含本機網路或 Tailscale 裝置 IP），以便儲存額外的 API 金鑰。接著，當它需要使用金鑰時，可以在 Shell 指令中透過類似 llm keys get anthropic 的指令來使用它。標籤：llm、coding-agents、codex

items_ai.title: Tencent's Gander aims to keep talking while it works in the background
items_ai.summary: Tencent's Gander processes speech, images, and text while handling tasks in the background. A "cerebellum" keeps the conversation going, while a swappable "brain" searches files, writes code, or tackles other complex work. Users can interrupt or change the task mid-conversation. In benchmarks, Gander interrupted users in just 8 percent of cases, less often than its rivals, but trailed on task accuracy. items_ai.title: llm-keys-ui 0.1
items_ai.summary: Release: llm-keys-ui 0.1 This plugin solves a very specific problem. I've started using Codex Remote to run coding agents on various machines while controlling them from my phone. Sometimes I use those machines to hack on LLM projects, and occasionally that means I need to configure an API key. I don't like pasting API keys into agent sessions, so I wanted a way to get those keys onto a machine without pasting them into the ChatGPT app directly. With this plugin, I can tell Codex to run: uvx --with llm-keys-ui llm keys-ui --all Then have it tell me the URL - including local network or Tailscale device IPs - for an interface to save additional API keys. Then later it can use a command like llm keys get anthropic as part of a shell command when it needs to use a key. Tags: llm , coding-agents , codex
items_ai.summary_zh: 釋出：llm-keys-ui 0.1 這個外掛程式解決了一個非常特定的問題。我開始使用 Codex Remote 在各種機器上執行編碼代理程式，同時透過手機來控制它們。有時候我會使用那些機器來開發 LLM 專案，這偶爾意味著我需要設定 API 金鑰。我不喜歡將 API 金鑰貼到代理程式的工作階段中，所以我希望有一種方法可以將這些金鑰放到機器上，而不需要直接將它們貼到 ChatGPT 應用程式中。有了這個外掛程式，我可以告訴 Codex 執行：uvx --with llm-keys-ui llm keys-ui --all 然後讓它告訴我介面的網址（包含本機網路或 Tailscale 裝置 IP），以便儲存額外的 API 金鑰。接著，當它需要使用金鑰時，可以在 Shell 指令中透過類似 llm keys get anthropic 的指令來使用它。標籤：llm、coding-agents、codex
